NEXO points to legal external sources. In-app downloads are only offered for public-domain books; everything else opens in your browser, where availability and rights depend on the provider.
NEXO is a reading app, not a bookstore: it helps you find where to read legally and keeps your library in sync.
Results come from public catalogs (Open Library, Project Gutenberg via Gutendex, Google Books) and optional community addons you install. Each result names its source.
The in-app download is only offered for public-domain books. Any other title opens externally in your browser, where the provider\'s terms and your region decide availability.
Addons run outside NEXO. An addon only resolves reading links after you grant it access to the book\'s title, author and identifiers, and you can revoke that access anytime from the addons screen.
